nodes.description: address payable private owner; contract owner set to msg.sender in the constructor and checked by the isOwner modifier.
address public nftAddress; address of the ERC721 NFT contract that VaultHandlerV4 mints, burns and transfers tokens on.
address public paymentAddress; ERC20 payment token used by buyWithPaymentOnly and for decimals().
address public recipientAddress; destination of the ERC20 payment taken from the buyer.
uint256 public price; price in payment-token units, computed as _price * 10 ** decimals.
string public metadataBaseUri; base URI concatenated with the token id to build the minted token URI.
mapping(address => mapping(uint => PreMint)) preMints; per-buyer pre-registered payload/preImage pairs consumed by buyWithPaymentOnly.
mapping(uint => PreTransfer) preTransfers; per-token escrow record holding the sender from whom the NFT is transferred in transferWithCode.
mapping(address => uint) preMintCounts; counter of pre-mints per address, incremented with SafeMath.add and decremented with SafeMath.sub.
mapping(uint => uint) preTransferCounts; counter of pre-transfers per token id, modified with SafeMath add/sub.
uint256 private _status; ReentrancyGuard lock variable toggled between _NOT_ENTERED and _ENTERED inside nonReentrant.
constructor(address _nftAddress, address _paymentAddress, address _recipientAddress, uint256 _price) public; sets owner to msg.sender and computes price with unchecked multiplication.
transferOwnership(address payable newOwner) public isOwner; transfers contract ownership to an arbitrary address.

buyWithPaymentOnly(address _to, uint256 _tokenId, string calldata image) public payable; verifies the payload hash, pulls ERC20 payment via transferFrom, then mints the NFT. NOT protected by nonReentrant.
addPreMint(address _for, string _payload, uint256 _tokenId, bytes32 preImage) public isOwner; probes the NFT contract with try/catch and stores a pre-mint entry.

transferWithCode(uint256 _tokenId, string calldata code) public payable; verifies the code hash and transfers the NFT from the registered pre-transfer sender to msg.sender. NOT protected by nonReentrant.
addPreTransfer(uint256 _tokenId, bytes32 preImage) public; registers a pre-transfer record. Public and unguarded by isOwner, so any caller can create/overwrite entries.
deletePreMint(address _for, uint256 _tokenId) public isOwner; removes a pre-mint entry and decrements the counter.
deletePreTransfer(uint256 _tokenId) public isOwner; removes a pre-transfer entry and decrements the counter.
claim(uint256 tokenId) public isOwner; burns the NFT with the given id through the external ERC721 contract.
changePrice(uint256 _price) public isOwner; recomputes price using an unchecked multiplication with 10 ** decimals.
modifier isOwner(); requires msg.sender == owner, gating claim, addPreMint, deletePreMint, deletePreTransfer, transferOwnership and all admin setters.
modifier nonReentrant(); inherited from ReentrancyGuard and toggles _status, but it is never applied to any state-changing VaultHandlerV4 function.
External untrusted call paymentToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, recipientAddress, price) inside buyWithPaymentOnly; executed before the NFT is minted and without a reentrancy lock.
External call nftToken.mint(_to, _tokenId, _uri, preMint.payload) after the payment pull; the NFT contract is an owner-controlled address.
External call nftToken.transferFrom(preTransfer._from, msg.sender, _tokenId) inside transferWithCode, executed before the pre-transfer state is cleaned up.
External call token.burn(tokenId) inside claim; the NFT contract address is mutable by the owner.
try IERC721(nftAddress).tokenPayload(_tokenId) external call with catch in addPreMint; the try/catch swallows failures and trusts the callee's return.
Unchecked arithmetic _price * 10 ** decimals used in the constructor and changePrice; no SafeMath wrapper, so overflow can silently wrap the price.
msg.sender; controls pre-mint lookups, becomes the NFT recipient in transferWithCode, is stored as PreTransfer._from, and is compared with owner in isOwner.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(address payable newOwner).
Parameter _to of buyWithPaymentOnly(address _to, ...); recipient of the minted NFT.
Parameter _tokenId of buyWithPaymentOnly(...); token id used to look up and delete the pre-mint.
Parameter image (calldata string) of buyWithPaymentOnly(...); hashed with sha256 and compared against the stored preImage.
Local PreMint memory preMint = preMints[msg.sender][_tokenId] inside buyWithPaymentOnly.
Local string _uri = concat(metadataBaseUri, uintToStr(_tokenId)) inside buyWithPaymentOnly.
Parameter _for of addPreMint(...); the address the pre-mint is created for.
Parameter _payload of addPreMint(...); stored in preMints and later passed to nftToken.mint.
Parameter _tokenId of addPreMint(...); key of the preMints mapping entry.
Parameter preImage of addPreMint(...); hash committed for the future buyWithPaymentOnly payload check.
Parameter _tokenId of transferWithCode(...); key for the preTransfers lookup and cleanup.
Parameter code of transferWithCode(...); hashed with sha256 and compared against the stored preImage.
Parameter _tokenId of addPreTransfer(...); key of the preTransfers records created by any caller.
Parameter preImage of addPreTransfer(...); secret hash required later by transferWithCode.
Parameter tokenId of claim(uint256 tokenId); the NFT id passed to the external burn call.
Parameter _price of changePrice(uint256 _price); multiplied by 10 ** decimals without SafeMath.
Local uint decimals = BasicERC20(paymentAddress).decimals() inside changePrice.
Local uint decimals = BasicERC20(paymentAddress).decimals() inside the constructor.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable, establishing the privileged account.
Untrusted msg.sender of the deployment transaction becomes owner with full admin rights.
The constructor executes the unchecked price multiplication without SafeMath.
The unchecked _price * 10 ** decimals result is written into the price state variable.
Constructor initializes price through an overflow-prone multiplication.
Constructor writes the NFT contract address into nftAddress.
Constructor writes the payment token address into paymentAddress.
Constructor writes the payout address into recipientAddress.
Constructor sets the hard-coded metadataBaseUri string.
transferOwnership is gated by the isOwner modifier.
isOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner address.
isOwner reads the owner state variable as the authorization reference.
transferOwnership overwrites owner with the caller-supplied newOwner.
claim is restricted to the owner by the isOwner modifier.
claim performs an external burn call on the configurable NFT contract.
The burn target is resolved through the nftAddress state variable.
addPreMint is restricted to the owner by isOwner.
addPreMint makes an external tokenPayload call wrapped in try/catch.
The try/catch probe targets the contract stored in nftAddress.
The external tokenPayload callee can re-enter addPreMint or other VaultHandlerV4 functions.
addPreMint increments preMintCounts for the target address.
addPreMint stores the payload and preImage into preMints.
deletePreMint is restricted to the owner by isOwner.
deletePreMint decrements preMintCounts with SafeMath.sub.
deletePreMint deletes the preMints entry keyed by _for and _tokenId.
buyWithPaymentOnly uses msg.sender as the preMint lookup key and as the payment source.
buyWithPaymentOnly reads and deletes the caller's preMints entry.
buyWithPaymentOnly performs the external ERC20 transferFrom payment call without a reentrancy lock.
The ERC20 payment is routed to the recipientAddress state variable.
A malicious payment token can re-enter buyWithPaymentOnly before state cleanup completes.
buyWithPaymentOnly calls the external NFT mint after taking payment, before deleting pre-mint state.
The mint target is the contract configured in nftAddress.
buyWithPaymentOnly decrements the caller's preMintCounts with SafeMath.sub.
transferWithCode uses msg.sender as the beneficiary of the NFT transfer.
transferWithCode performs the external NFT transferFrom before clearing the pre-transfer record.
The transfer source is read from the preTransfers state variable.
The NFT contract callback can re-enter transferWithCode while preTransfers is still populated.
transferWithCode decrements preTransferCounts after the transfer.
addPreTransfer is public with no isOwner guard, so any msg.sender can register itself as the pre-transfer sender and overwrite existing records.
addPreTransfer writes the caller-supplied sender into preTransfers.
addPreTransfer increments preTransferCounts without checking the token is actually owned.
deletePreTransfer is restricted to the owner by isOwner.
deletePreTransfer decrements preTransferCounts with SafeMath.sub.
deletePreTransfer deletes the preTransfers entry.
changePrice is restricted to the owner by isOwner.
changePrice reuses the unchecked price multiplication logic.
changePrice overwrites the price state variable with a result that can overflow.
nonReentrant toggles the _status guard variable.
The nonReentrant guard exists but is not applied to buyWithPaymentOnly, leaving the external-call flow unprotected.
The nonReentrant guard is not applied to transferWithCode, leaving the NFT transfer flow unprotected.
